name: migrate_logger
description: Migrates all .js/.mjs files in a directory (recursive) from log(level, ...) to logger.<level>(...), updates the logger import, and renames formatId to formatID. Returns changed files and any leftover log( usages needing manual review.
whenToUse: When migrating a directory of modules off the deprecated log() API.

dir.description: Directory relative to the project root, e.g. src/modules
